name: mumro-web-verification
purpose: Two-tier Playwright & multimodal browser verification for workspace auth, shell geometry, and composer flows.

ui-contract.purpose: Fast, deterministic verification of routes, auth refresh queues, and 390x844 mobile geometry without external services.

integrated.purpose: End-to-end journeys against local frontend + backend with disposable QA accounts (QA-A / QA-B).

authSessionPolicy.rationale: Concurrent workers sharing one single-use refresh token trigger reuse detection and revoke the session family.

scenarios.title: Silent refresh single-flight under concurrent 401 responses
Mobile shell drawer and dialog overflow check (390x844)

programmaticInvariants: dialog close button inside viewport boundingBox
multimodalRubric: No overlapping badges or clipped headings in the mobile drawer
Primary action button remains visually distinct and unobstructed

scenarios.title: Workspace draft creation and Prepare -> Confirm preview modal

skills.name: verify-browser-scenarios
skills.description: Verify UI-contract and integrated Playwright scenarios with ARIA locators, DOM geometry invariants, and targeted VLM screenshots. Use when an issue or task packet references M-AUTH-01, M-UX-01, or M-COMPOSE-01.
